en.title: Keel
en.tagline: Tax does not go to a wallet. It goes into a position.
en.treasuryHint: Read from Venus when this page loaded. Nobody publishes it.
en.split: Every distribution: {holders} to holders, {project} to the project. Read from the vault; constant in this implementation, with no setter.
en.auto: This vault settles itself every 5 minutes. You do not need to press anything.
en.autoNoBounty: That automatic path pays no bounty at all — Flap's trigger service has already taken its fee out of the vault. The bounties below are earned only when that clock has stopped.
en.manualHint: Only needed if the schedule ever stops. Nothing here depends on the project still being around to press it.
en.permissionless: No permission is needed. Any address can call these, and the contract pays the caller a bounty out of the BNB that call moves. The rates are read from the vault and are constant in the deployed implementation — no owner or role can change them, though the Flap Guardian can replace the implementation behind the beacon.
en.bountyDeploy: Pays the caller {bps} bps of the BNB deployed.
en.bountyHarvest: Pays the caller {bps} bps of the gain released.
en.bountyRebalance: Pays the caller {bps} bps of the BNB freed.
en.bountyNone: Pays no bounty. It only re-arms the schedule.
en.stageBoth: These three calls only move BNB the vault already holds, so they work the same on the bonding curve and after the token is listed.
en.connect: Connect a wallet to use the manual fallback.
en.wrongNetwork: Switch the wallet to {chain} to use the manual fallback.
en.riskLine: Contract risk status, as reported by the host: {status}
en.riskIntegrationMissing: The host is not reporting a risk status for this vault. Treat it as unverified until it does.
en.warnLiquidation: These calls move a live {lev} position. It is liquidated once its BNB collateral falls {pct}.
en.warnUnaudited: The vault has been submitted to Flap for review and no third-party security audit has been completed. It depends on Venus and PancakeSwap.
en.warnRevert: A call can revert. The gas is spent either way and you get nothing back for it.
en.risk: A {lev} position is liquidated once its BNB collateral falls {pct}. Venus and PancakeSwap are dependencies. Submitted to Flap for review; no third-party security audit has been completed.
en.topWarning: This vault holds a {lev} leveraged position on Venus. It is not a savings product.
en.topBody: If BNB falls {pct} against the position, Venus liquidates it and the treasury is permanently smaller. Nobody can undo that and the contract has no pause. The code has been submitted to Flap for review; no third-party security audit has been completed. It depends on Venus and PancakeSwap staying solvent and reachable. Swaps carry no slippage bound: a build that gets sandwiched reverts, but a harvest or rebalance completes at whatever price the pool gave. Every button below is permissionless and pays its caller — anyone may press them, and a call can revert and cost gas with nothing to show. Every number on this page comes from a view function you can call yourself.

zh.title: Keel
zh.treasuryHint: 本页加载时从 Venus 读出,没有任何人对外公布这个数。
zh.split: 每次分配:持有者 {holders}、项目方 {project}。数值从合约读出;在当前实现里写死,没有修改函数。
zh.auto: 这个金库每 5 分钟自动结算一次。你不需要按任何按钮。
zh.autoNoBounty: 自动这条路一分赏金都没有——Flap 的定时服务已经先从金库里收走了它的费用。下面这些赏金,只有在定时链条停掉之后才拿得到。
zh.manualHint: 只在定时链条中断时才需要。这里没有一件事依赖项目方还在。
zh.permissionless: 不需要任何权限。任何地址都能调用,合约会从这次调用搬动的 BNB 里付给调用者一笔赏金。费率从合约读出,在当前实现里是常数——没有 owner、没有角色能改,但 Flap Guardian 可以替换 beacon 背后的实现。
zh.bountyDeploy: 调用者可得部署金额的 {bps} bps。
zh.bountyHarvest: 调用者可得本次释放收益的 {bps} bps。
zh.bountyRebalance: 调用者可得再平衡释放出的 BNB 的 {bps} bps。
zh.bountyNone: 不付赏金,它只负责重新排定结算。
zh.stageBoth: 这三个调用只搬动金库已经持有的 BNB,所以内盘阶段和代币上所之后都一样可用。
zh.connect: 连接钱包后可使用手动兜底。
zh.wrongNetwork: 切换到 {chain} 之后才能使用手动兜底。
zh.riskLine: 宿主报告的合约风险状态:{status}
zh.riskIntegrationMissing: 宿主没有为这个金库报告风险状态。在它报告之前,请按未审核对待。
zh.warnLiquidation: 这些调用动的是一个真实的 {lev} 杠杆仓位。BNB 抵押品下跌 {pct} 时它就会被清算。
zh.warnUnaudited: 金库已提交 Flap 审核,尚未完成第三方安全审计,并且依赖 Venus 与 PancakeSwap。
zh.warnRevert: 调用可能回滚。无论成不成 gas 都花掉了,而你什么也拿不到。
zh.risk: {lev} 仓位在 BNB 抵押品下跌 {pct} 时被清算。Venus 与 PancakeSwap 是依赖项。已提交 Flap 审核;尚未完成第三方安全审计。
zh.topWarning: 这个金库持有的是 Venus 上的 {lev} 杠杆仓位,不是储蓄产品。
zh.topBody: BNB 反向下跌 {pct},Venus 就会清算它,国库将永久变小。没人能撤销,合约也没有暂停开关。代码已提交 Flap 审核,尚未完成第三方安全审计,并且依赖 Venus 与 PancakeSwap 保持偿付能力和可访问。所有兑换都没有滑点下限:建仓被夹会整笔回滚,但收割和再平衡会按池子给的价成交。下面每个按钮都是无许可的,并且付钱给调用者——任何人都能点,一次调用也可能回滚、白花 gas。页面上的每个数字都来自你可以自己调用的 view 函数。
